rows.ja: クラウド・技術提携先

relations.text: NetAppの自社製品はAmazon Web Servicesと標準連携する
relations.text_en: NetApp's first-party products integrate natively with Amazon Web Services

source.label: NetApp 10-K
source.quote: Our first-party native integration with all major hyperscalers—Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud—combined with decades of data management leadership, uniquely enables customers to harness these shifts for competitive advantage.

relations.text: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAPが、AWS上のSiemens Teamcenter向けに認定された
relations.text_en: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP was certified for Siemens Teamcenter on AWS

source.label: NetApp 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • NetApp announced that Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP ™ was certified for Siemens Teamcenter on AWS , bringing enhanced performance, scalability, and data management capabilities to product lifecycle management workloads in the cloud.

relations.text: NetAppはNVIDIA、Cisco、Microsoftなどと協業して統合ソリューションを提供する
relations.text_en: NetApp collaborates with technology leaders including NVIDIA, Cisco and Microsoft to deliver integrated solutions

source.label: NetApp 10-K
source.quote: Collaborations with technology leaders such as NVIDIA, Cisco, Microsoft, and a broad network of channel partners enable us to deliver integrated, best-in-class solutions tailored to diverse customer needs.

relations.text: NetAppはGoogle Cloudとの標準連携を持つ
relations.text_en: NetApp has native integration with Google Cloud

source.label: NetApp 10-K
source.quote: Our native integration with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud provides customers with significant flexibility, unified management, and consistent data services across any environment.

relations.text: ONTAPについてNVIDIA DGX SuperPOD Storage Certificationの手続きを始めると発表した
relations.text_en: NetApp announced it was beginning NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD Storage Certification for NetApp ONTAP

source.label: NetApp 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • NetApp announced its vision to accelerate AI innovation, including beginning the process of NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD Storage Certification for NetApp ONTAP™ , the creation of a global metadata namespace , a vision for a disaggregated storage architecture for ONTAP, and direct integration of AI data pipelines in the cloud and on-premises.

relations.text: NVIDIAなどとの協業が、NetAppの統合ソリューション提供を支える
relations.text_en: NetApp's collaboration with technology leaders including NVIDIA underpins its integrated solutions

source.label: NetApp 10-K
source.quote: Collaborations with technology leaders such as NVIDIA, Cisco, Microsoft, and a broad network of channel partners enable us to deliver integrated, best-in-class solutions tailored to diverse customer needs.

relations.text: FlexPodの連携により、共同顧客がCiscoのネットワークとNetAppのストレージを併用できるとされている
relations.text_en: The FlexPod integration lets joint customers use Cisco networking and compute alongside NetApp storage

source.label: Nutanix and NetApp · April 7, 2026 strategic alliance and planned integration
source.label_en: Nutanix and NetApp · April 7, 2026 strategic alliance and planned integration
source.quote: FlexPod has set the standard for converged infrastructure, and this integration will allow our joint customers to leverage Cisco’s high-performance networking and compute alongside NetApp storage and NCP, providing a unified, secure, and highly automated environment that simplifies the transition to modern, cloud-native operations.”

relations.text: CiscoはNetAppが協業するテクノロジーリーダー
relations.text_en: Cisco is one of the technology leaders NetApp collaborates with

source.label: NetApp 10-K
source.quote: Collaborations with technology leaders such as NVIDIA, Cisco, Microsoft, and a broad network of channel partners enable us to deliver integrated, best-in-class solutions tailored to diverse customer needs.

relations.text: CapgeminiとNetAppが、Azureへの移行で2024 Microsoft Partner of the Yearを受賞した
relations.text_en: Capgemini and NetApp received a 2024 Microsoft Partner of the Year Award for a migration to Azure

source.label: NetApp 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Microsoft recognized Capgemini and NetApp with a 2024 Microsoft Partner of the Year Award in the “Migration to Azure” category for the companies’ work in moving a large retail customer in Asia to Azure, including Azure NetApp Files.

relations.text: 富士通のPRIMERGYサーバーとNetAppのストレージを使う中小企業向けの仮想化ソリューションを発表した
relations.text_en: NetApp announced a bundled virtualization solution using Fujitsu PRIMERGY servers and NetApp storage

source.label: NetApp 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • NetApp announced a new bundled virtualization solution for small and medium businesses that uses VMware vSphere 8 virtualization software, Fujitsu PRIMERGY Servers, and NetApp all-flash storage systems with NetApp ONTAP™ integration to vSphere .

companies.name: ニュータニックス
companies.sub: ハイブリッドクラウド

relations.text: NutanixがNetApp ONTAPベースの外部ストレージ連携への対応を発表した
relations.text_en: Nutanix announced support for NetApp ONTAP-based external storage integration

source.label: Nutanix 10-K
source.quote: We have also announced support for NetApp ONTAP-based and Lenovo ThinkSystem external storage integrations, with the NetApp ONTAP-based solution currently available through limited-availability programs.
source.note: 限定提供プログラムの段階です。

companies.name: センチネルワン
companies.sub: サイバーセキュリティ

relations.text: SentinelOneは、Amazon S3とNetAppにある悪意あるファイルから顧客を保護するとしている
relations.text_en: SentinelOne says customers receive protection from malicious files in Amazon S3 and NetApp

source.label: SentinelOne 10-K
source.quote: Customers receive protection from malicious files in Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) and NetApp.

relations.text: NetAppはLenovoに一部のOEM販売を行う
relations.text_en: NetApp makes certain OEM sales to Lenovo

source.label: NetApp 10-K
source.quote: our offerings to customers headquartered there, and involved in certain OEM sales to Lenovo.

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.が管理代理人を務める第2次改定クレジット契約(2025年3月5日付)がある
relations.text_en: NetApp has a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated March 5, 2025 with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: NetApp 10-K
source.quote: Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated as of March 5, 2025, by and among NetApp, Inc., the lenders from time to time party thereto and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

companies.name: ヒューレット・パッカード・エンタープライズ

relations.text: ネットアップと競合する

source.label: Hewlett Packard Enterprise 10-K
source.quote: Our primary competitors are other infrastructure and cloud management software technology vendors, such as Broadcom, Cisco Systems Inc., Dell Technologies Inc., IBM, NetApp Inc., Nutanix, and Pure Storage and public cloud vendors like Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
